interface.longDescription: Create one to four matched PNG concepts for game icons, individual sprites or backgrounds, optionally using an attached style reference. Refine a selected asset and inspect results inline with Open, Download and fullscreen. These are concept images, not guaranteed transparent files, engine-ready sprite sheets or 3D models. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
